hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).tool_input?.command||""))' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push.*main'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct push to main is blocked. Create a feature branch and open a PR instead."}}'; fi
